description: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has partnered with the Odisha government to design and implement Integrated Financial Management System (IFMS) 3.0.
body_lead: TCS to manage Odisha govt's AI-enabled integrated financial system The company has been working with the state government since 2005, beginning with the integrated Odisha Treasury Management System Listen to This Article Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has partnered with the Odisha government to design and implement Integrated Financial Management System (IFMS) 3.0. The company has been working with the state government since 2005, beginning with the integrated Odisha Treasury Management System.
